## Global Aesthetic Options
```{r}
library(sf)
library(arcgis)
library(mapview)
library(janitor)
library(tidyverse)
library(sysfonts)
library(showtext)
library(ggh4x)

# colors 
soe_colors <- c(
  red    = "#DD5A54",
  blush  = "#EDBFB2",
  orange = "#EC940C",
  blue   = "#608ED8",
  olive  = "#737F2E",
  forest = "#283523"
)
soe_palette <- unname(soe_colors)

## add fonts
font_add_google("Fraunces", "Fraunces")
font_add_google("Manrope", "Manrope")
showtext_auto()
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)

# ggplot theme
theme_soe <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = "Manrope") +
    theme(
      text             = element_text(color = soe_colors["forest"]),
      plot.title       = element_text(family = "Fraunces", face = "bold",
                                      size = rel(1.4)),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(face = "italic", size = rel(1.1)),
      axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border     = element_rect(color = soe_colors["forest"],
                                      fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      strip.background = element_rect(color = soe_colors["forest"],
                                      fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      strip.text       = element_text(family = "Fraunces", face = "bold",
                                      color = soe_colors["forest"])
    )
}
theme_set(theme_soe())

```


## Read and tidy data 
```{r}
setwd("~/Google Drive/My Drive/Teaching/ES-314/Class Research/data")

nri <- read_csv("NRI/NRI_Table_CensusTracts.csv") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  filter(stateabbrv %in% c("MA", "CT", "ME", "NH", "RI", "VT")) |> 
  select(tractfips, county, stateabbrv, risk_value, hwav_riskv, hrcn_riskv) |> 
  mutate(
    risk_pct_rank = percent_rank(risk_value) * 100,
    hwav_pct_rank = cume_dist(hwav_riskv) * 100,
    hrcn_pct_rank = cume_dist(hrcn_riskv) * 100)
```


## 1. Average NRI scores
Calculate average percentile rank risk score for Norfolk, and MA
```{r}
# MA- 48th percentile in NE
nri |> filter(stateabbrv == "MA") |> select(risk_pct_rank) |> summary()


# Norfolk County - 60th percentile in NE
nri |> filter(stateabbrv == "MA" & county == "Norfolk") |> select(risk_pct_rank) |> summary()
```

## 4. Combined Bar graph
```{r}
score_cols <- c("risk_pct_rank", "hwav_pct_rank", "hrcn_pct_rank")

# state scores
by_state <- nri |>
  group_by(stateabbrv) |>
  summarise(
    across(all_of(score_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  mutate(geography = if_else(stateabbrv == "MA", "Massachusetts", "EPA Region 1"))

# county scores
by_county <- nri |>
  filter(stateabbrv == "MA", county == "Norfolk") |>
  group_by(stateabbrv) |> 
  summarise(
    across(all_of(score_cols), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
  mutate(geography = "Norfolk County")

# df for creating bar chart 
bar_df <- bind_rows(by_state, by_county) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(risk_pct_rank, hwav_pct_rank, hrcn_pct_rank),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "avg_pct_rank") |>
  mutate(
    metric = factor(
      metric,
      levels = c("risk_pct_rank", "hwav_pct_rank", "hrcn_pct_rank"),
      labels = c("Average Risk", "Average Heat Wave", "Average Hurricane")),
    facet = factor(
      geography,
      levels = c("EPA Region 1", "Massachusetts", "Norfolk County"))) |> 
filter(!(facet == "EPA Region 1" & stateabbrv == "MA")) |> 
   mutate(stateabbrv = ifelse(stateabbrv == "MA", " ", stateabbrv))

ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = stateabbrv, y = avg_pct_rank, fill = metric)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(avg_pct_rank)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_grid(~ facet, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average percentile rank",
    fill = NULL
  ) + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")

rm(by_county, by_state, bar_df, score_cols)
```


## 5. Map of Avg Projected Heat by cities/towns + county over it ? 
[MAPC towns](https://share-open-data-metroboston.hub.arcgis.com/datasets/6f2c0c8e89f541a8bd8e5611da058bea_0/explore)
[Background info on towns](https://www.mass.gov/info-details/massgis-data-2020-us-census-towns)
[NASA heat data](https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/sedac-ciesin-sedac-crv-uscrpc-2040-2049-1.00#overview), extreme heat is defined as number of events exceeding the 97.5th percentile of daily maximum baseline temperature for three consecutive days in the 2040s. 

Notes: I feel like the Norfolk map could be better, maybe add stations and lighten the lines? 
```{r}
setwd("~/Google Drive/My Drive/Teaching/ES-314/Class Research/data") 
# list Norfolk towns 

norfolk_county_towns <- c(
  "Avon",
  "Bellingham",
  "Braintree",
  "Brookline",
  "Canton",
  "Cohasset",
  "Dedham",
  "Dover",
  "Foxborough",
  "Franklin",
  "Holbrook",
  "Medfield",
  "Medway",
  "Millis",
  "Milton",
  "Needham",
  "Norfolk",
  "Norwood",
  "Plainville",
  "Quincy",
  "Randolph",
  "Sharon",
  "Stoughton",
  "Walpole",
  "Wellesley",
  "Westwood",
  "Weymouth",
  "Wrentham")

# pull extreme county heat data
clim_risk <- st_read("US_CRP_2040-2049/Shapefile/crv-us-climate-risk-proj-county-2040-2049.shp")

## tidy data
ne_states <- states(cb = TRUE) |> filter(STATEFP %in% c("09", "23", "25", "33", "44", "50")) |> 
  st_transform(4269)

heat_tidy <- clim_risk |> 
  mutate(state = substring(GEOID, 1, 2)) |> 
  filter(state %in%c("09", "23", "25", "33", "44", "50")) |> 
  mutate(heat_cat = cut(HeatExt,
  breaks = c(27, 36, 40, 44, 53),
  labels = c("27-36", "36-40", "40-44", "44-53")))

heat_tidy <- st_intersection(heat_tidy, st_union(ne_states))
ma_heat <- heat_tidy |> filter(state == "25")

# counties and towns 
url <- "https://services.arcgis.com/c5WwApDsDjRhIVkH/arcgis/rest/services/MAPC_Towns_poly_2025/FeatureServer/0"
mapc <- arc_read(url) |>  st_transform(4269) |> st_make_valid() |> 
  filter(municipal %in% c(norfolk_county_towns))

norfolk <- heat_tidy |> filter(GEOID == "25021")

## Commuter Rail stops
furl <- "https://arcgisserver.digital.mass.gov/arcgisserver/rest/services/AGOL/MBTA_Commuter_Rail/FeatureServer/1"
layer <- arc_open(furl)
stops <- arc_select(layer) |>  st_transform(4269)


## NE Map
ne_map <- ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = heat_tidy, aes(fill = heat_cat), color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = ne_states, fill = NA, color = "black", lwd = 0.4) + 
scale_fill_manual(values = c("#edbfb2", "#cd8b7e", "#ac584c", "#88201b")) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

## MA map 
ma_map <- ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = ma_heat, aes(fill = heat_cat), color = "black") +
scale_fill_manual(values = c("#edbfb2", "#cd8b7e", "#ac584c", "#88201b")) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

## Norfolk map 
## calculate # of stops in each town 
mapc$no_stops <- lengths(st_intersects(mapc, stops))


norfolk_map <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = norfolk, aes(fill = heat_cat), color = "white") +
    geom_sf(data = mapc, fill = NA, color = "black") +
  #geom_sf(data = st_centroid(mapc), aes(size = no_stops)) +
    geom_sf_text(
        data = mapc,
        aes(label = municipal),
        size = 2.5,
        family = "Manrope",
        check_overlap = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#edbfb2")) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

## add labels
strip_title <- theme(
  plot.title = element_text(
    hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11,
    margin = margin(b = 4)))

p1 <- ne_map      + ggtitle("New England")  + strip_title
p2 <- ma_map      + ggtitle("Massachusetts") + strip_title
p3 <- norfolk_map + ggtitle("Norfolk County") + strip_title

#   nri, stations, storms, strip_title, p1, p2, p3, ma_map, ne_map, url)
```


## 6. Storm Events & secondary risks 
NOAA_Norfolk_storm_events_1950-2025, filtered for heat, wind, rain, flood and snow
Power outages? Eagle-I percentile of power outages for each geography and flood risk index percentile 
```{r}
storms <- read_csv("~/Google Drive/My Drive/Teaching/ES-314/Class Research/Climate - Cher/NOAA_norfolk_storm_events_1950_2025.csv")

outages <- read_csv("~/Google Drive/My Drive/Teaching/ES-314/Class Research/data/eagle-I/eaglei_outages_2025.csv") |> 
  filter(state == "Massachusetts") |> 
  mutate(start_date = as_date(run_start_time))

county_daily_outages <- outages |>
  filter(county == "Norfolk") |>    
  mutate(start_date = as_date(start_date),                
    customers_out = replace_na(customers_out, 0)) |>
  group_by(fips_code, county, start_date) |>
  summarize(customers_out = sum(customers_out))

## storm data 
storms <- storms |> 
  filter(YEAR == 2025) |> 
  mutate(start_date = as_date(BEGIN_DATE_TIME)) |> 
  group_by(EVENT_TYPE, start_date) |> 
  summarize(n_events = n()) |> 
      mutate(x_plot = start_date + (row_number() - 1) * 0.4) |> 
  mutate(EVENT_TYPE = ifelse(EVENT_TYPE %in% c("High Wind", "Strong Wind", 
                                               "Thunderstorm Wind"), "Wind", EVENT_TYPE))

## plot 
ggplot(county_daily_outages, aes(x = start_date, y = customers_out)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_vline(
    data = storms,
    aes(xintercept = start_date, color = EVENT_TYPE),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    transform = "pseudo_log",
    breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000),
    labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#EC940C", "#608ED8"), name = "Storm event") +
  labs(title = "Customer Outages",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Customers out (log scale)") + 
  theme(legend.position = "right")

rm(county_daily_outages, outages, storms)
```



## 7. Heat index & secondary risks 

```{r}
ne_states <- c("CT", "ME", "MA", "NH", "RI", "VT")

vars <- c(
  total_pop   = "B01001A_001",
  m_u5        = "B01001A_003",
  f_u5        = "B01001A_018",
  m_65_74     = "B01001A_014", m_75_84 = "B01001A_015", m_85p = "B01001A_016",
  f_65_74     = "B01001A_029", f_75_84 = "B01001A_030", f_85p = "B01001A_031",
  nh_white    = "B03002_003",
  dis_total   = "B18101A_001",
  dis_18 = "B18101A_003", dis_18_64 = "B18101A_006", dis_65 = "B18101A_009",
  hh_total    = "C16002_001",
  lep_spanish = "C16002_004", lep_indoeuro = "C16002_007",
  lep_asian   = "C16002_010", lep_other    = "C16002_013")

# query data 
raw <- map_dfr(ne_states, \(st) {
  get_acs(
    geography = "tract",
    state     = st,
    variables = vars,
    year      = 2024,
    survey    = "acs5",
    output    = "wide"  
  )
})

# tidy 
tract_summary <- raw |>
  transmute(
    GEOID, NAME,
    state = str_trim(str_extract(NAME, "[^,]+$")),
    total_pop = total_popE,
    pct_under5 = 100 * (m_u5E + f_u5E) / total_popE,
    pct_over65 = 100 * (m_65_74E + m_75_84E + m_85pE + 
                          f_65_74E + f_75_84E + f_85pE) / total_popE,
    pct_poc = 100 * (total_popE - nh_whiteE) / total_popE,
    pct_disability = 100 * (dis_18E + dis_18_64E + dis_65E) / dis_totalE,
    pct_lim_eng = 100 * (lep_spanishE + lep_indoeuroE + lep_asianE + lep_otherE) /
                             hh_totalE)

## add homelessness and chronic illness data 
places <- read_csv("~/Google Drive/My Drive/Teaching/ES-314/Class Research/data/PLACES__Local_Data_for_Better_Health,_Census_Tract_Data_2024_release_20251016.csv") |> 
  filter(StateAbbr %in%c(ne_states)) |> 
  filter(Measure %in% c("Housing insecurity in the past 12 months among adults", "Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease among adults", "Current asthma among adults", "Diagnosed diabetes among adults")) |> 
  clean_names() |> 
select(location_name, state_abbr, county_name, 
       short_question_text, data_value) |> 
  pivot_wider(names_from = short_question_text, values_from = data_value) |> 
  clean_names()

heat_vuln <- places |> 
  left_join(tract_summary, by = c("location_name" = "GEOID")) |>
  left_join(nri, by = c("location_name" = "tractfips")) 

## Dot Plot for Norfolk, MA, and NE
# prep data 
summary_vars <- c("hwav_pct_rank", "copd", "housing_insecurity", "current_asthma", "diabetes", "pct_under5", "pct_over65", "pct_poc","pct_disability", "pct_lim_eng")

summarize_geo <- function(df, label) {
  df |>
    summarize(across(all_of(summary_vars), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
    mutate(geography = label)
}

var_groups <- tribble(
  ~vulnerability,       ~group,
  "hwav_pct_rank",      "Heat",
  "copd",               "Health",
  "current_asthma",     "Health",
  "diabetes",           "Health",
  "housing_insecurity", "Social vulnerabilities",
  "pct_under5",         "Social vulnerabilities",
  "pct_over65",         "Social vulnerabilities",
  "pct_poc",            "Social vulnerabilities",
  "pct_disability",     "Social vulnerabilities",
  "pct_lim_eng",        "Social vulnerabilities")

dot_df <- bind_rows(summarize_geo(filter(heat_vuln, state_abbr == "MA", 
                                         county_name == "Norfolk"), "Norfolk County"),
  summarize_geo(filter(heat_vuln, state_abbr == "MA"), "Massachusetts"),
  summarize_geo(heat_vuln, "New England")) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(summary_vars), names_to = "vulnerability", 
               values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(geography = factor(geography, 
                     levels = c("Norfolk County", "Massachusetts", "New England"))) |>
  select(value, vulnerability, geography) |> 
  left_join(var_groups, by = "vulnerability") 

# Plot 
vuln_labels <- c(
  hwav_pct_rank      = "Heat risk (percentile rank)",
  copd               = "COPD (%)",
  current_asthma     = "Adult asthma (%)",
  diabetes           = "Diabetes (%)",
  housing_insecurity = "Housing insecurity (%)",
  pct_under5         = "Children under 5 (%)",
  pct_over65         = "Adults over 65 (%)",
  pct_poc            = "People of color (%)",
  pct_disability     = "With a disability (%)",
  pct_lim_eng        = "Limited English (%)")

dot_df |>
  mutate(group = factor(group,
                   levels = c("Heat", "Health", "Social vulnerabilities"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(value, vulnerability)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = vulnerability), color = "gray70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = geography), size = 2) +
  facet_grid2(group ~ ., scales = "free", space = "free_y", independent = "x") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = vuln_labels) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#DD5A54", "#EDBFB2", "#EC940C"))  

#rm(tract_summary, places, raw, vars)
```
